methodology.command_segments: timestamp of serial task log marker until next marker; includes subprocess/build overhead; not individual test CPU time
methodology.elapsed: latest job completed_at minus run_started_at; exclude reruns from headline metrics
methodology.invalid_timestamp_policy: One cancelled run has job completion before start; elapsed excluded. Reused rerun jobs with start before creation have null queue. Preserve source timestamps; never clamp negatives to zero.
methodology.queue: job started_at minus job created_at; dependency waiting is separate
methodology.source_api: GitHub REST Actions run/attempt/job timestamps and job logs
methodology.version_check: candidate SHA workflow full-validation needs barrier checked via contents API for each of 100 candidates
